Our story

A café for the street it sits on.

We opened in 2020 in a converted front room, mostly because the street had nowhere to sit down. Six tables then, nine now, and the same two of us behind the counter.

The coffee is from four Philippine farms and the kitchen is small on purpose — rice plates, eggs, and whatever the bakery two streets over sends across that morning.

Notes

Often asked

Do you take reservations?

Not for tables — seating is first come. For six or more, message us and we will try to hold space.

Can I order ahead?

Yes, and it is the quickest way past the morning queue. Tap any contact button and send your order.

Do I pay through this page?

No. There is no checkout here; this page is for orders and enquiries only.

Is there a time limit?

None, and no minimum spend. We only ask you free the bigger tables at lunch if you are alone.

Do you have non-dairy milk?

Oat and soy, both at no extra charge. Just say so when you order.

Can I buy the beans?

Everything on the board is on the retail shelf too, ground to your brewer.

See you soon

Come by, or send your order.

Message us your order and a pickup time, or just walk in — there is usually a table free.
